open_text_result: Substantial but not asserted complete open Greek witness coverage is available. Eutocius explicitly transmits Menaechmus' construction of two mean proportionals by parabola and hyperbola (section 31); the Eratosthenes material preserved beside it names the ‘Menaechmian conic triads’. Plutarch, Theon, Speusippus, and Suda supply further doctrinal, biographical, and title notices. These are licensed source witnesses, not a reproduction of Lasserre's seven-item arrangement or modern apparatus.
